chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to eat watermelon with dates.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet eat with watermelon?
ai.summary: This brief narration from Al-Kafi highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him) practice of combining watermelon with dates, a dietary habit often cited in Shia tradition to illustrate the Sunnah of eating complementary foods. Scholars note that this combination is not merely culinary but reflects the Prophetic emphasis on moderation and the synergistic nutritional benefits of pairing fruits, aligning with the broader Islamic principle of maintaining physical health as a trust from God.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, form his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> ate the melon with the dates’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, would eat melons with dates.’”
